fusions.name: Threaded Dive
fusions.desc: Sends a sliver of shadow into the first enemy it meets that deals 30 damage and ignores armour. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Seam Search
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 9 damage, uses up one of your afflictions on the target and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dead-Eye Hour
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds, and you regain 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Mended Seam
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
